description: The effective configuration is inspectable without exposing inline or MCP credentials.

setup_home_files.config.toml:
provider = "vllm"
base_url = "http://127.0.0.1:{port}/v1"
model = "e2e-model"
[typesafe]
api_key = "INLINE_SECRET_123"
[mcp.servers.fake]
command = "python"
args = ["--token", "ARG_SECRET_123"]
env = { PASSWORD = "ENV_SECRET_123" }
url = "https://user:URL_SECRET_123@example.test/mcp?token=QUERY_SECRET_123#FRAG_SECRET_123"
